personality_one_liner: A high-impact, stadium-night aesthetic built for the grassroots Sepak Takraw community—bold, energetic, and always free.

spacing.rule: Generous tactile spacing on cards, tight operational spacing on timers/counters.

do's: Use heavy glass on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers to keep the energetic background glows visible but abstracted.
Apply glass overlay on the Countdown Hero Card to ensure the text remains legible over the court background.
dont's: Do not blur individual list rows or form fields.
Do not over-lighten the glass. Stick to dark tinted overlays (surfaceSecondary opacity at ~75%).

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Primary operational dashboard highlighting the NEXT MSTC EVENT countdown.

states.empty: No upcoming events state: Show 'TBD' or 'No upcoming event yet' inside the hero card with a friendly message.
states.error: Failed to load event data. Show retry button.

screens.layout: Root background must feature a soft red glow (#e0362c at 20% opacity) at the top-right and a faint yellow glow (#fcd116 at 15% opacity) at the bottom-left using blurred absolute views or SVG radial gradients. Top section: Large 'NEXT MSTC EVENT' card taking up 40% of the screen. Display the timer (Days : Hrs : Mins) in Barlow Condensed 4xl. The card should use the court drone image as a background, with a heavy top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceSecondary) to guarantee text contrast. Below the hero card: Quick glance of the latest Announcement.

screens.name: Announcements
screens.purpose: Feed of newest-first posts including events, recruitment, and training notices.

states.empty: Illustration of a Sepak Takraw ball with text 'No announcements yet'.
states.error: Could not fetch announcements. Show error and reload CTA.

screens.layout: Vertical ScrollView of cards using surfaceTertiary background. Titles in display font, body in muted textFont. Highlight 'Recruitment' or 'Event' tags using brandTertiary background with brand text.

screens.name: Notifications
screens.purpose: In-app history of pings and updates.

states.empty: Bell icon in surfaceTertiary circle. 'You are all caught up.'

screens.layout: Simple, dense list layout. Unread notifications have a brandSecondary (yellow) left border (borderStrong) or dot.

screens.name: Enquiry
screens.purpose: Contact form for community queries via Formspree.
screens.layout: Single column form inside a KeyboardAvoidingView. Labels above inputs. Inputs use surfaceTertiary background with border on focus (brandSecondary). Sticky 'Submit Enquiry' button anchored to the bottom.

screens.name: Tools
screens.purpose: Hub for utility features: Training timer, Warm-up guide, Score counter, and Rules reference.
screens.layout: Grid of touchable tiles (2-col grid). Each tile has an icon and a title. Selecting a tile pushes a new screen. E.g., The Score Counter should be a high-contrast horizontal layout with oversized tap areas for left/right teams. The Training Timer uses massive display typography and a circular progress indicator.

hero_court_background.alt: Drone shot of a local Philippine sports court

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the Dark-First Utility DARK rules. The app should feel like a command center for a sports community—high contrast, operational, energetic.

Implement the global screen background with the user's specific request: near-black (#0a0a0c) with a soft red glow at the top right and a faint yellow glow at the bottom left. You can achieve this via blurred absolute positioned `<View>` components or Skia/SVG radial gradients placed behind the main content.

The Hero Countdown Card is the focal point of the Home screen. Render the Days, Hours, and Minutes as large segmented blocks using Barlow Condensed. It must support multiple states: standard countdown, 'TBD', 'No upcoming event yet', and 'Event in Progress' (perhaps pulsating red for live).
Use yellow (#fcd116) strictly for highlights, links, and focus outlines (e.g. active tab icon, focused text input). Use red (#e0362c) for primary call-to-actions, echoing the Philippine flag styling.
When rendering cards, alternate between #101014 (surfaceSecondary) for sections and #141419 (surfaceTertiary) for elevated cards.
Ensure all text rendered over images (like the Hero Countdown Card over the court background) uses a heavy top-to-bottom gradient scrim to guarantee text readability.
For the MSTC Website tab/action, implement an external link open to 'https://mstc.pages.dev/'.
Never use pure blue or purple. The palette is strictly near-black, warm off-white, red, and yellow.
Add subtle haptic feedback for all tab changes, timer toggles, and form submissions.
